scope: Focused read-only review of the R3 execution packet, supervisor, and no-Cargo preflight. No Cargo, Nextest, CLI, tests, or build were launched by reviewer; this is not execution authorization.

checks.name: source, review, cache, and R17 input bindings
checks.detail: R3 runner pins the 12-file package and recomputes its length-prefixed digest; validates the R3 source freeze/review/patch/inventory/format audit/R1 erratum; checks the exact R6 cache receipt and its 85 rows; and rechecks all eight immutable R17 request/selection/capture files. Preflight records the same source/review/cache/tool/R17 digests.

checks.name: test selection and stage commands
checks.detail: The first child selects exactly the 26 source-derived lib tests through the complete pinned filter, with locked/offline mode, retries 0, build jobs 2, test threads 1, and libtest-json-plus v0.1. Reader build and R17 Rust CLI reprocessing are separate stages, gated on successful preceding stages; the CLI is passed the pinned request, selection, and trusted selection SHA. Node stores raw streams and child facts only; it does not parse Nextest or reader JSON.

checks.name: skipped-stage status
checks.detail: Result field r17_reprocess_status is derived from actual stage objects: RAN_EXIT_0 / RAN_NONZERO_OR_SIGNALLED when the reader ran, NOT_RUN_READER_BUILD_FAILED when build ran unsuccessfully, and NOT_RUN_NEXTEST_FAILED_OR_CANCELLED when Nextest did not succeed or was cancelled. The limitations boolean is derived as Boolean(reader && reader.stage_exit_ok), not hard-coded true.

checks.name: bounds and preflight
checks.detail: Runner uses detached process groups, one 30-minute deadline, 15-minute Nextest/build limits, a 30-second CLI limit, bounded TERM/KILL/reap windows, a 4 MiB per-stage and 1 MiB CLI output cap, and bounded raw capture. Preflight is PREFLIGHT_PASS_NO_CARGO_NO_TEST, binds runner and packet hashes, reports 26 selected tests, 85 source-cache files, pinned tools, and the fresh attempt root absent.

checks.name: authorization boundary
checks.detail: Packet remains PREPARED_FOR_ROOT_REVIEW_NOT_AUTHORIZED; preflight says authorized=false. The R2 25/26 exit-100 fixture inconsistency is preserved as history, and its CLI build/reprocessing remain recorded as skipped.
